purpose: Teach: 特製/作風/家系/ごっこ/島国/走り出し/七つ/遠回り

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ママ特製のカレー、世界一!
lines.en: Mom, Mom's special curry is the best in the whole world!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement bursting out on 「世界一」. Quick tempo, open vowels. Genuine childish wonder, not performed. Natural rising energy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ。お祖父ちゃんの作風、引き継いだの。
lines.en: Hehe. I inherited Grandpa's cooking style.
lines.style: Warm, indulgent laugh. Soft pride underneath — not boasting, just stating fact. Gentle, maternal tone. Voice settles on the second phrase.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うちの家系、料理上手なのかな。
lines.en: Does our whole family have a talent for cooking?
lines.style: Wondering aloud, genuinely curious. Slow, thoughtful pace. The kind of quiet observation kids make when they're noticing patterns. Small voice but sincere.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お料理ごっこ、楽しいよね。
lines.en: Playing with cooking is fun, isn't it.
lines.style: Gentle, affirming. Slight smile in the voice. Speaking to his observation without dismissing it. Warm but not saccharine. Patient presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 日本は、島国だから、ご飯と魚が、定番だね。
lines.en: Japan is an island country, so rice and fish are the basics.
lines.style: Thoughtful, piecing ideas together. Not rushed. The small voice of a child making a genuine connection. Slight trailing uncertainty — checking his own logic.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Gentle shift in tone. Noticing something — not accusatory, just aware. Warm but now grounded. A mother checking in. Soft, steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。あと七つ、問題、残ってる。
lines.en: Yeah. I've still got seven problems left.
lines.style: Slight wry recognition of the situation. Not complaining, just stating fact. A tiny bit of weariness creeping in. Still honest, still small voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 帰り道、遠回りして、お友達の家、寄ろうね。
lines.en: On the way home, let's take a detour and stop by your friend's place.
lines.style: Warm, gentle permission wrapped in invitation. Not an obligation — an offer of a moment. Voice settles with kindness. The reassurance of inclusion.
